1	/**
2	 * SidecarClient — HTTP client used by the Cloudflare Worker to delegate
3	 * operations that require Node.js capabilities (filesystem access, child
4	 * processes, plugin loading) to the Paperclip Node server running alongside
5	 * the Workers deployment.
6	 *
7	 * Background:
8	 *   - The Node server (heartbeat.ts) provisions git checkout directories and
9	 *     workspace paths via node:fs/promises and node:child_process, which are
10	 *     not available in the Workers runtime.
11	 *   - company-skills.ts reads and writes skill Markdown files on the local
12	 *     host filesystem; R2 replaces long-term storage but live validation and
13	 *     execution still need a process.
14	 *   - agent-instructions.ts manages a per-agent directory tree of Markdown
15	 *     files through node:fs/promises; R2 replaces storage but some operations
16	 *     require filesystem materialisation.
17	 *
18	 * The Worker authenticates every request to the sidecar with a shared secret
19	 * (Bearer token) so that only Workers traffic is accepted.
20	 *
21	 * All code here is Web-API-only — no Node imports.
22	 */
23	
24	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	// Configuration
26	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	
28	export interface SidecarConfig {
29	  /** Base URL of the sidecar process, e.g. https://sidecar.internal */
30	  baseUrl: string;
31	  /** Shared secret for Worker → sidecar authentication (Bearer token). */
32	  apiKey: string;
33	}
34	
35	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	// Response shapes returned by the sidecar
37	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
38	
39	export interface WorkspaceProvisionResult {
40	  workspacePath: string;
41	  leaseId: string;
42	}
43	
44	export interface SkillBundleResult {
45	  /** Map of relative file path to file content string. */
46	  files: Record<string, string>;
47	}
48
